_comment: M6b agent-level procedure mutations. Each AM mutates an isolated temporary copy of SKILL.md (never the canonical file - integrity is proven by SHA-unchanged), runs one fresh agent review against the paired Group E scenario, and expects the named contract failure. Baseline PASS is reused from the corresponding Gate-3 clean run. Reverse check: restoring the unmutated SKILL.md makes the scenario PASS again.
